summary: Episode ep_014 (EP14) shows Juliana retrieving the emerald signet ring from blackthorns, trading it to a Police Constable for Alexander's release, then taking him home to bandage her hands in a cottage. The on-screen events do not establish who 'they' are, what was promised, why Alexander was shackled, or what the ring means. The closing vow and bucket of blood imply a threat, but the source doesn't name it. Metadata (logline and continuity note about Episode 13's cliffhanger) was not treated as on-screen evidence and is unverified here. Timestamps are taken from the supplied event ranges in integer milliseconds.

characters.name: Juliana
characters.role: Protagonist who recovers the ring at great physical cost and secures Alexander's release

characters.name: Alexander
characters.role: Juliana's husband, shackled and then freed; protective and vengeful by the end

characters.name: Police Constable
characters.role: Guard who takes the ring and unlocks Alexander's cuffs; affiliation unclear

beats.description: Juliana pulls the emerald ring from the thorns and steps out, injured, announcing she found it.
Juliana demands her husband's release and hands the ring to the Constable.
The Constable removes Alexander's iron cuffs and Alexander rushes to Juliana.
Alexander inspects Juliana's wounds in anguish; she says the cost was what 'they' promised.
Juliana asks to go home and Alexander carries her away from the estate.
The couple reaches an isolated stone cottage under stormy skies.
Alexander bandages Juliana's hands by the fire; they exchange apologies and reassurance.
Alexander wraps Juliana in a blanket; she says she took his place and he is doing it better.
Alexander vows no one will hurt her again for protecting him, and his fist clenches as the scene cuts to black.

revelations.claim: Juliana's injuries were part of an arrangement with unnamed parties ('they') who made promises.
creates_questions: Who are 'they' and what did they promise?

revelations.claim: Juliana implies she took Alexander's place in some ordeal, and Alexander is now doing that role better.
creates_questions: What was the place Juliana took for Alexander?

revelations.claim: Alexander's vow suggests Juliana was endangered because she protected him, and he intends to retaliate.
creates_questions: Who threatened Juliana for protecting Alexander?
